summary: This snapshot lands with the US session already in progress, so what follows is a live read rather than an overnight one. The composite risk score is 42.73 and eased -0.44 on the day, while the weekly change stays positive at 0.26; the level holds the caution band and the regime still reads goldilocks. The easing came from the calm side of the model rather than the stretched side: volatility scores 23.2 with the index at 14.9 against 15.15 prior, and liquidity and credit score 33.05 with high yield spreads at 2.7 against 2.71 prior. Macro is the one dimension doing damage at 65.33, because the real ten-year rate at 2.43 sits in the 99.04 percentile and the nominal ten-year at 4.69 sits in the 97.99 percentile. Underneath a quiet index the leadership has flipped: cloud computing +2.9327, cybersecurity +2.7798 and enterprise software +2.3371 are bid, while networking -2.2359, semiconductor equipment -1.8135 and memory -1.3339 are sold, with Nvidia -1.8887 and Advanced Micro Devices -1.4337 leading the hardware side lower. That is rotation rather than de-risking, but it thins the leadership: the new highs ratio is only 0.1169 against breadth of 0.6818. The sector input is degraded and the single largest contribution, 7.50, still comes from a proxy at 0.5, so the cross-market read stays provisional. The next hard test is the consumer price report midweek, followed by producer prices and retail sales.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro is the only stretched dimension at 65.33: the real ten-year rate at 2.43 sits in the 99.04 percentile and the nominal ten-year at 4.69 in the 97.99 percentile, with the two-year at 4.25.

The largest single contribution to the composite, 7.50, comes from a proxy: cross-asset confirmation reads 0.5 on a dimension scoring 50.0 with coverage of only 0.80, so the top driver is an estimate rather than a measured signal.

The front-end liquidity buffer is thin: reverse repo at 1.45 sits in the 7.39 percentile and carries a risk score of 85.22, contributing 3.41 inside a liquidity and credit block that otherwise scores 33.05.

Equity leadership is narrowing: the new highs ratio is 0.1169 with a risk score of 68.31 against breadth of 0.6818, and semis relative strength is -1.8591, so the tape is being carried by fewer names.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility is the calmest dimension at 23.2, with the index at 14.9 in the 20.79 percentile against 15.15 prior and realized volatility at 13.9895.
Credit is not confirming stress: high yield spreads at 2.7 sit in the 8.79 percentile against 2.71 prior, and investment grade holds 0.78 in the 17.6 percentile, unchanged from the prior print.
The long-term trend is intact: the index sits 10.004 above its long-run average, the fifty-two week drawdown is 0.0, and three-month momentum is 4.9131.

contradicting_signals.claim: The sector split looks like rotation, not de-risking: cloud computing +2.9327, cybersecurity +2.7798 and enterprise software +2.3371 are bid against networking -2.2359, semiconductor equipment -1.8135 and memory -1.3339 -- but the sector input is degraded, so the split is indicative only.

The domestic A-share memory and packaging names print broadly positive in this snapshot while the US memory theme is -1.3339 and Micron is -0.2473; with the sector input degraded and the two markets not aligned on the same session, that divergence cannot be used as confirmation.

Labor quality is worse than the headline: the payroll change is -23.0 against 20.0 prior, participation slipped to 61.4 from 61.5 and continued claims rose to 1801000 from 1777000, yet the unemployment rate fell to 4.1 from 4.2.

what_changed_today: The composite eased -0.44 to 42.73 on the day while the weekly change stays positive at 0.26, so the move is a give-back inside an upward week rather than a turn.
The relief came from volatility and credit: the index printed 14.9 against 15.15 prior and high yield spreads 2.7 against 2.71 prior, and both dimension scores are falling.

The rates block did not participate and stays at the stretched end: the ten-year is 4.69 against 4.63 prior, the two-year 4.25 against 4.18 prior, the real ten-year 2.43 against 2.41 prior, and the curve 0.44.
Leadership flipped inside technology, with software and cloud bid and artificial intelligence hardware sold: Nvidia -1.8887 and Advanced Micro Devices -1.4337, while bitcoin also softened to 64204.0.
watch_next: The consumer price report is the first hard test and lands midweek, in the same session as the Cisco print.
Producer prices follow the next session and retail sales the one after, so three high-importance United States releases sit inside the window.
The implied policy rate is 3.69 with the read on the next action a hold; a soft inflation print is the first thing that would move it.
Whether the software over hardware rotation persists: semis relative strength at -1.8591 and the new highs ratio at 0.1169 are the two tells to watch.

bull_case.title: Bull case: disinflation lets the long end come down
points: Headline inflation is 3.46353 against 4.16661 prior, core is 2.56579 against 2.82294 and core personal consumption is 3.28653 against 3.42158, so all three measures are easing.
Inflation expectations stay contained, with the five-year forward at 2.28 against 2.29 prior and the ten-year breakeven at 2.25 against 2.26, so the market is not pricing a re-acceleration.
Volatility at 23.2 and credit at 33.05 are the two lowest dimension scores; with the index at 14.9 and high yield spreads at 2.7 there is no funding stress that has to unwind first.

base_case.title: Base case: quiet tape, stretched macro, nothing resolves before the data
points: The score holds near 42.73 in the caution band and the regime stays goldilocks, because macro at 65.33 is offset by volatility at 23.2 and credit at 33.05.
Confidence is 0.9191 and rests on data quality of 1.0 and coverage of 0.93, but consistency is only 0.7356 and the evidence state is partial.
The largest contribution of 7.50 comes from a proxy at 0.5, so the composite is anchored by an estimate; a genuine regime change would have to show up in volatility or credit first.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the real rate breaks the goldilocks frame
points: The real ten-year rate at 2.43 is in the 99.04 percentile and the nominal at 4.69 in the 97.99 percentile; at those levels the discount rate does the damage regardless of the growth path.
Equity internals are thin: the new highs ratio is 0.1169 against breadth of 0.6818 and semis relative strength is -1.8591, so a narrow tape has little cushion if the leaders roll over.
Labor is deteriorating beneath the headline, with payrolls at -23.0 against 20.0 prior, continued claims at 1801000 against 1777000 and participation at 61.4 against 61.5.
